evidence: Paying the same bill twice is frustrating. I'm sorry.

evidence: Let me make sure I have it right: two charges of $84.50 on the 3rd, for one bill?

evidence: So, the duplicate $84.50 will be refunded to your bank in 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today?
